title: Where the Wild Things Are
author: Maurice Sendak
summary: After being sent to bed without supper for misbehaving, Max sails to an island of monsters and is crowned their king. When he grows lonely, he returns home to find his dinner waiting for him.
readIf: you want a short, imaginative bedtime story about big feelings for a young child.
skipIf: you are looking for a detailed story with much text or plot.
